parameters.query:
WITH allowed AS (
    SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.user_roles ur
      JOIN public.role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id
      JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id
     WHERE ur.user_id = $1::uuid
       AND COALESCE((to_jsonb(ur) ->> 'is_active')::boolean, true)
       AND p.code = 'HELP_CATALOG_SYNC'
  ) AS ok
), picked AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.help_video_requests
     WHERE status = 'pending' AND (SELECT ok FROM allowed)
     ORDER BY created_at
     LIMIT $2::int
     FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE public.help_video_requests r
   SET status = 'processing', updated_at = now()
  FROM picked
 WHERE r.id = picked.id
RETURNING r.id, r.use_case_id, r.locale, (SELECT ok FROM allowed) AS allowed;
